title: Computational assessment of clerodane-type furano-diterpenoids from Tinospora crispa: A potential source for anticancer lead compounds.
authors: Anjum, Juhaer; Spriha, Sabiha Enam; Hossain, Mir Sabit; Rahman, S M Abdur
one_liner_zh: 该文为植物来源小分子抗癌化合物的计算筛选与分子动力学评估，对象为小分子-蛋白靶标，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Tinospora crispa, a plant with widespread use in ethnomedicine, has several extracts as well as phytoconstituents that have been reported to possess anticancer properties. Clerodane-type furano-diterpenoids from this genus of plants show promise as anticancer agents, although only a few of these have been assayed in vitro. 38 clerodane-type furano-diterpenoids from T. crispa were assayed computationally against 13 common anticancer macromolecular targets. The assayed ligand library displayed higher binding affinities than the respective controls in six of the thirteen anticancer macromolecular targets. Binding affinity values that were higher than the respective controls were obtained for two ligands against BRCA1, for four against CDK9/Cyclin T1, for two against C-ROS1, for thirty-seven against EGFR, for three against MEK 1-kinase, and for one against STAT3. Many of these ligands displayed greater binding affinity values than the respective controls against multiple macromolecules. Notable among these are tinocrispide (against BRCA1, C-ROS1, EGFR and MEK1), tinosporol C (against CDK9/Cyclin T1 and MEK1-kinase), crispene E (against BRCA1 and CDK9/Cyclin T1) and (5R,6R,8S,9R,10R,12S)-15,16-Epoxy-2-oxo-6-O-(beta-D-glucopyranosyl)-cleroda-3,13(16),14-trien-17,12-olid-18-oic acid methyl ester (against BRCA1 and EGFR). The top scoring compounds of each macromolecule were subjected to molecular dynamics simulations, and the obtained protein-ligand complexes were observed to be stable for all macromolecules except EGFR. The ligand library was mostly predicted to be soluble, but GI absorption was predicted to vary. A few were predicted to be carcinogenic, immunotoxic, and/or cytotoxic. Overall, the clerodane-type furano-diterpenoids from T. crispa show encouraging results in in-silico studies and may be considered for further modification and lead development.
abstract_zh: Tinospora crispa，一种在民族医学中广泛使用的植物，其多种提取物及植物成分已被报道具有抗癌特性。来自该属植物的Clerodane型呋喃二萜类化合物显示出作为抗癌剂的潜力，尽管其中仅有少数已在体外实验中进行了测试。对来自T. crispa的38种Clerodane型呋喃二萜类化合物，针对13个常见的抗癌大分子靶点进行了计算评估。在所测试的配体库中，有六个抗癌大分子靶点显示出比相应对照更高的结合亲和力。对于BRCA1，有两种配体获得了高于相应对照的结合亲和力值；对于CDK9/Cyclin T1，有四种；对于C-ROS1，有两种；对于EGFR，有三十七种；对于MEK 1-激酶，有三种；对于STAT3，有一种。许多这些配体在多个大分子上显示出比相应对照更高的结合亲和力值。其中值得注意的是tinocrispide（针对BRCA1、C-ROS1、EGFR和MEK1）、tinosporol C（针对CDK9/Cyclin T1和MEK1-激酶）、crispene E（针对BRCA1和CDK9/Cyclin T1）以及(5R,6R,8S,9R,10R,12S)-15,16-Epoxy-2-oxo-6-O-(beta-D-glucopyranosyl)-cleroda-3,13(16),14-trien-17,12-olid-18-oic acid methyl ester（针对BRCA1和EGFR）。每个大分子的最高得分化合物进行了分子动力学模拟，观察到的蛋白质-配体复合物在除EGFR外的所有大分子中均保持稳定。配体库大多预测为可溶性，但胃肠道吸收预测存在差异。少数被预测具有致癌性、免疫毒性和/或细胞毒性。总体而言，来自T. crispa的Clerodane型呋喃二萜类化合物在计算机模拟研究中显示出令人鼓舞的结果，可能值得进一步修饰和先导化合物开发。
